title: Pair of scan states
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean tape alphabet, a paired scan state consists of two scan states, each having three optional machine-cell entries and a Boolean entry.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
